retake.beyondMax: A fourth retake needs the Vice-Chancellor's approval

probation.then: Dismissed ('excluded') in the fourth term; no readmission and no fresh start

honours.note: Also used by the RDS extension (rds-cgpa-extension). No NSU page states these; confirm with the registrar before showing them as official.

creditLoad.note: An overload needs written permission, but no numeric maximum is published.

records.rule: All required 100-level courses must be passed by the third term, or no higher-level registration (English excepted).
A required 100-level course failed in two attempts blocks registration in every other course except English until it is passed.
ENG105 must be passed by the fourth term.
After completing 80% of required credits, non-core courses may be excluded from the record, but not to avoid probation, change department or get financial aid.
Normally needs a CGPA of 3.00 within three terms and 27 credits completed in the current program.
An undergraduate degree must be completed within six years of enrolment.
Up to 50% of credits, only grades of C or above, and transferred grades do not count in the NSU CGPA.

termCodes.pattern: two-digit year followed by 1 (Spring), 2 (Summer) or 3 (Fall): 252 is Summer 2025, 263 is Fall 2026

days.note: Section day strings concatenate these codes: ST is Sunday and Tuesday, MW Monday and Wednesday, RA Thursday and Saturday.
